findings.finding: The three Vermont forms name their widgets with bare ordinals, so no caption can be inferred from a field name.
findings.consequence: Every caption in the field map was read off the page at the widget's coordinates and is re-checked on every build.

findings.finding: 600-00228 is a financial affidavit and the platform holds none of its figures.
findings.consequence: 112 blanks across the packet are required-before-filing and every one is named in participant-instructions.md.

findings.finding: 200-00132 requires the State's Attorney's signature before the court will act on it.
findings.consequence: Those three fields are refused as court/prosecutor-owned and the instructions tell the participant the stipulation route needs the prosecutor's agreement.
